# Ripples Template — Research & Tasks

## Source Reference

- **ColorLib Source**: Accordion 11 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/accordion-11/`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/bac/accordion-11/`
- **Category**: Accordion / FAQ Showcase
- **New App Name**: `ripples`

## Section Breakdown & Structure

1. **Header / Hero Section**: Clean title introduction ("Bootstrap Accordion #1") and subtitle.
2. **Interactive Accordion Component**: List of collapsible FAQ / information panels with smooth expand/collapse toggle behavior.
3. **Footer**: Clean minimalist footer featuring copyright and mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design Notes & Tokens

- **Colors**: Slate text, primary blue accents, clean white cards on light neutral background.
- **Interactivity**: Fully accessible keyboard navigation and ARIA expanded states for accordion headers.
